title: Edit Staff Member shows the same toggle row as New Staff Member
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have any active staff member, staff member A.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps: 1. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Edit Staff Member window opens.
  • Below the Billable field there is a row holding only three toggles, in this order: Time Clock, Sales Representative, Technician.
  • The row is in the same place and order as in the New Staff Member window.
  • The "Technician" label carries a "New" pill at its top right.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member)

  • S1-R1: “The New Staff Member and Edit Staff Member windows (Settings, Staff) show a toggle labeled "Technician" directly to the right of the Sales Representative toggle, as the last toggle in that row (Time Clock, Sales Representative, Technician). In both windows the three toggles share one row of their own, below the Billable field, so New and Edit look the same, in the same style as the window's other toggles.”
  • S1-R2: “A "New" pill sits at the top right of the "Technician" label, touching the end of the word. It looks the same as the pill on the Work Orders display switcher. It shows until 07:00 UTC on the seventh day after the release that ships this feature, then disappears for everyone, including in a window that is already open. The moment is fixed in UTC and read from the viewer's own clock: the pill shows while that clock is before it and is gone from that moment on. The exact date is set when the release is scheduled.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "2 Turn Technician on for a staff member", pictures "Technician off" (This build) and "Edit Staff Member" (Production today (before))

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p2-05-after-technician-off.png
  • tt-p2-04-before-edit-staff-member.png

The design's own words:

  • “Technician is off: on release day it was turned on only for people who, in the last 90 days, had time on a work order, lead or are on a line of an open work order, or are billable. She was none of those.”
  • “Time Clock on, so today she is offered as a technician everywhere (pages 5 and 6), with no way to say otherwise.”
